summary: Iteration 16 e2e: product variants (seed + selection + cart + checkout pass-through), description line-break preservation, product detail modal, admin variants editor, and regressions (Event Pass rules, coupon maths, filter tabs, admin tabs, catalog sync diff). Backend: 12/12 new pytest cases pass plus 5/5 auth-playbook and 28/28 hybrid-coupon regressions. Frontend: all requested flows verified on desktop (1920) and mobile (390). No functional defects found; only 3 minor/cosmetic issues.

ui_bugs.issue: React console error on /products: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option> ... This will cause a hydration error'. The option child is a JSX expression pair ({v.label} — {money(v.price)}) which the editor instrumentation wraps in a <span>. Render a single precomputed string instead, e.g. {`${v.label} — ${money(v.price)}`}.
Radix a11y warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for DialogContent'. Add <DialogDescription> (or aria-describedby) for screen readers.

design_issues.screen: Admin > product editor > Fetch from SellAuth
issues: Fetch prefills variant labels as the full remote name ('Weekly Event Ticket (Basic)', 'Weekly Event Ticket (Ultra Box)') instead of the short option name, so an unedited fetch would render very long labels in the storefront dropdown. Consider stripping the product-name prefix / parentheses when prefilling.

line-clamp-5 with whitespace-pre-line means a blank line between paragraphs consumes one of the 5 visible rows, so multi-paragraph descriptions show very little teaser text. Functional (full text is in the modal), cosmetic only.

action_items: Optional: fix the <option> child expression to avoid the hydration/console error (ProductCard.jsx L126, ProductDetailDialog.jsx L61).
Optional: shorten variant labels produced by the SellAuth Fetch prefill.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1332 lines — consider splitting routers (products/orders/coupons/admin) into modules; models.py + sellauth.py are fine.

resolve_items() variant handling is correct: invalid variant_id -> 400 'That option is no longer available for <name>', missing variant_id -> first variant, price/label/variant id all re-derived server side (never trusted from the client).

line_key() = productId:variantId is used consistently by compute_discount and checkout, so per-variant lines and per-line coupon spreading stay in sync; discount_eligible() still blocks event_pass by category AND SellAuth product id, so variant-priced passes can never be discounted.
seed_variants() is idempotent (skips products that already have variants) and prices from live SellAuth, so a manual admin edit is never overwritten.

rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no functional defect reproduced. The two console warnings are non-blocking: the <option> hydration error comes from the dev visual-editor wrapping the option's dynamic text nodes in a <span>, and the Radix DialogContent warning is a missing aria-describedby.
